title: My conversation archive
hint: View conversations saved on the server. User messages and Agent replies are stored separately, with a separate record for each retry.
adminHint: Only super administrators can access other users' conversations. Queries and exports are audited.
exportHint: Downloads to this computer. Exports include finished attempts in this range; export active replies again after they finish. Images include metadata only. Complete files end with a completion record. Time filters use submission time.
empty: No archived conversations in this range.
select: Select a conversation to view both sides.
deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this server archive? Browser history is stored separately.
failed: The operation failed. Please try again.
saveFailed: This reply could not be fully archived on the server. Keep a copy of the content on this page.
